architecture_rule: Oblivion Findings is one operating organisation with multiple Sites. Bounded static route/action ownership does not establish permission, Site/privacy/lifecycle correctness, runtime behaviour, or release readiness.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review scoped executive KPIs, insights, and Site summaries.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action resolves aggregate scope and composes executive KPIs, insights, and Site summaries for the exact canonical executive-insights job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review live bank balances and near-term financial obligations.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: Bank and petty-cash balances, calculated cash totals, and near-term obligations form the single cash-position job; the obligation aggregator is a supporting dependency.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review finance obligations over a selected calendar range.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The index renders the finance calendar shell and its closed companion event feed; together they resolve the single obligation-calendar job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review the financial position of one authorised Site.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action resolves one Site and returns its dashboard, variance, Site insights, and date filters as one Site financial-position job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review the scoped costs, funding, invoices, and ledger summary for one Client.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action resolves one Client and supplies the selected-range summary and running ledger for the canonical Client-financial-summary job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Preview, create, and post an FX revaluation to the general ledger.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The index presents dated revaluations, gains or losses, posting status, journal, notes, and creator as the canonical FX-revaluation entry surface.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Record a daily vehicle check against its authorised template
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: Vehicles, today's checks, outcomes, and progress form the daily-check workspace; roadworthiness and alert values are contextual aggregates, not second action owners.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, update, and remove authorised fleet geofences
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: Geofence filtering, Site and asset selectors, active coverage, and breach telemetry all support the single geofence-management job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: View and export the authorised H&S governance report family
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action produces the requested board-level Health and Safety summary; its metrics are sections of one governance-report job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Receive signed provider events and project them idempotently
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action verifies signed provider input, binds Site and device identity, rejects conflicting duplicates, and stages events idempotently through a closed adapter registry as one webhook-intake job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Use the authorised portal client workspace and section-gated summary
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The method builds one authorised, section-gated Client workspace; domain projections are workspace sections rather than invocations of their separate actions.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Read, mark, and acknowledge owned notifications
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action resolves only the authenticated user's notification and marks it read; the back response is not an alias route.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Read, mark, and acknowledge owned notifications
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action acknowledges only an owned notification that requires acknowledgement, directly implementing the canonical personal-inbox job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Upload, download, and remove private privacy evidence
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The target is resolved by a closed privacy-evidence allowlist; multiple record types remain variants of one generic evidence-attachment job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Execute approved retention and preserve governed evidence
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action invokes one approved retention execution and reports its governed result through the closed retention-owner registry.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review and export a cross-domain privacy compliance report only for domains the actor is independently authorised to view.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The explicit report variants resolve to in-class writers and remain variants of one cross-domain compliance-report export job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Configure Site provider connections and governed secrets
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action creates or locks the UniFi connection, stores the governed secret, updates credential state, and audits recovery replacement for one provider-connection job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Synchronise provider Sites, applications, and devices
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: Closed UniFi adapter bindings resolve discovery; the action discovers Sites and hosts, persists discovery state, and records one provider-sync lifecycle.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Export visible device, event, and maintenance registers
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action bounds an optional device set, queries the visible register, and streams device-inventory columns for the single reporting-export job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Configure application privacy and compliance settings and maintain the processor register.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action validates and persists only the application privacy-settings object as the privacy branch of the single data-governance feature.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Configure application-level calendar provider connections, approved-Site resource mappings, cadence, and conflict policy.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The action disables or upserts one Site's provider-resource mapping, direction, and source filters, then enforces one live mapping for the calendar-connection job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Find, inspect, assign, watch, split, and report authorised tasks across canonical providers
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: A statically bounded provider registry resolves the generic workbench detail composition while underlying records retain their separate canonical ownership.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Browse Site-eligible published guidance and provide feedback; authorised IT managers govern article lifecycle.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: Validation and lifecycle service delegation resolve draft creation and audit for the knowledge-base job; redirecting back follows the mutation and is not an alias.
